summary: The Financial Health Network Accelerator appears to have ended. The official program page says the Accelerator was active from 2014 to 2019 and there is no current public application window or ongoing cadence.

sources.title: Accelerator - Financial Health Network
sources.supports: Official program page states the Accelerator was a program in partnership with JPMorgan Chase that identified, supported, and scaled fintech innovators from 2014 to 2019.

sources.title: Financial Health Network - Programs
sources.supports: Official programs page lists current and past programs; the Accelerator is presented among programs with no active application call shown.

notes: No current cohort, application deadline, program dates, or demo day were found on the official accelerator page.
Because the official page dates the program to 2014-2019, this should be marked inactive rather than added as a current event.
